Our results establish the RG flow as a natural formulation for relating galaxy bias measurements at different cutoffs and connecting the schemes used in field-level and $n$-point function analyses.

title: Dwarf galaxy simulations with stellar-core mass- and metallicity-dependent core-collapse supernova explosion energies
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究关注暗物质晕中重子物质如何冷却、坍缩、形成恒星，并在恒星反馈、化学增丰和星系风的作用下形成今日观测到的星系性质与标度关系。恒星反馈的核心之一是大质量恒星的核心坍缩超新星（CCSNe）：它们向星际介质注入能量、动量、湍流和金属，驱动星系风、调节恒星形成效率，并影响星团形成与重子循环。传统上，亚网格模型把每次 CCSN 的能量取为固定值，常用 $1\,\mathrm{B}=10^{51}\,\mathrm{erg}$（1 Bethe），但三维 CCSN 模拟表明爆发是否成功以及爆发能量取决于前身星核心质量、金属丰度、对流和中微子加热等，$E_\mathrm{expl}$ 可在 $<0.1$ 至 $2\,\mathrm{B}$ 间变化；失败的爆发和抛射物回落会留下黑洞。矮星系引力势浅、金属丰度低，是检验恒星反馈、星系风质量加载和重子循环的理想实验室。
contribution: 作者在 SPHGal 星系演化代码中实现了依赖于恒星核心质量和金属丰度的可爆发性判据与 CCSN 爆发能量 $E_\mathrm{expl}$ 参数化方案，计入超新星失败形成黑洞以及抛射物部分回落形成黑洞，并采用与三维 CCSN 模拟校准的爆发-前身星关系，使 $E_\mathrm{expl}$ 在 $<0.1$ 至 $2\,\mathrm{B}$ 间变化。作者对孤立的低金属丰度星系开展模拟，并改变输入的恒星反馈模型。主要结果为：**新判据下形成的黑洞数约为传统 CCSN 模型的三倍，但失败 CCSN 比例较低，成功爆发数目的减少对星系恒星形成影响很小**；**黑洞形成虽从重子循环中移除物质，但重子循环仍主要由星系风驱动，且大部分致密遗骸质量储存在白矮星中**。最显著的变化来自新的平均爆发能量仅约为传统亚网格模型所假设 $1\,\mathrm{B}$ 的 $\sim33\%$：**这使恒星形成增强且爆发性减弱、星系风与质量加载因子降低、星团形成效率提高，并增强恒星形成区的化学增丰与金属循环**。这些结果与较低分辨率星系模拟中通常假设 $1\,\mathrm{B}$ 的 CCSN 反馈即可匹配观测标度关系的图像形成对比。
summary: Core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe) are a critical source of thermal and kinetic energy and chemically enriched material in galaxies. Leveraging recent advances in CCSN modelling, we implement a novel core-mass- and metallicity-dependent prescription for stellar explodability and CCSN explosion energies, $E_\mathrm{expl}$, in the SPHGal galaxy evolution code. It accounts for black hole (BH) formation via SN failures and via partial fallback of ejecta mass, and adopts an explosion-progenitor connection calibrated to three-dimensional CCSN simulations, such that $E_\mathrm{expl}$ varies between $<0.1$-$2\, \mathrm{B}$. We ran simulations of isolated low-metallicity galaxies with variations in the input stellar feedback models. With the new explodability prescription nearly three times more BHs form compared to the canonical CCSN-model, but the reduced number of successful CCSNe has minimal impact on galactic star formation owing to the low fraction of failed CCSNe. While BH formation contributes to removal of matter from the galactic baryon cycle, the latter remains driven by galactic outflows, and most compact remnant mass is stored in white dwarves. The most significant change is instead brought about by the new average-$E_\mathrm{expl}$ that amounts to $\sim33$\% of the $1\,\mathrm{B}=10^{51}\, \mathrm{erg}$ traditionally assumed in sub-resolution CCSN-models. This reduction results in increased and less bursty star formation, reduced outflows and mass-loading factors, increased star cluster formation efficiency, and enhanced chemical enrichment and metal-recycling in star-forming regions. These results stand in contrast with outflow-launching and baryon cycle modelling in lower-resolution galaxy simulations in which canonical (i.e., $1\, \mathrm{B}$) CCSN feedback is typically assumed to produce galaxy models that match observed scaling relations.

title: New Constraints on the Ultrahigh Energy Neutrino Flux from the First Array-Wide Search with the Askaryan Radio Array
background_knowledge: 超高能中微子，即能量 $E_\nu \gtrsim 100\ \mathrm{PeV}$ 的中微子，是高能宇宙线源和宇宙线传播的重要信使。它们可在源区通过 $p\gamma$、$pp$ 等强子过程产生，也可由超高能宇宙线（UHECR）与宇宙微波背景光子相互作用（GZK 过程）产生；后者使“宇生中微子”成为检验 UHECR 源模型的独特窗口。中微子几乎不偏折且能穿透致密环境，但探测需要超大靶体积。南极冰盖提供了巨大、射电透明的天然介质。Askaryan 效应是指相对论粒子级联在介质中产生电子过剩，并发出纳秒级相干射电 Cherenkov 脉冲；当射电波长大于级联横向尺度时信号相干增强。ARA 在南极点冰中布设天线阵列，通过多站符合、波形时序和极化信息寻找这类短脉冲，以压制热噪声和人造背景，并对弥散超高能中微子通量设置上限。
contribution: 论文报道 ARA 首次全阵列（array-wide）弥散超高能中微子搜寻，分析了 ARA 十余年数据中迄今最大的 Askaryan 探测器数据集。搜寻**未发现候选事件**，预期背景为 $0.13\pm0.01\ (\mathrm{stat.})^{+0.05}_{-0.06}\ (\mathrm{syst.})$ 个事件；由此得到的通量上限在 $50\ \mathrm{EeV}$ 至 $1000\ \mathrm{EeV}$ 能段为当前最严格，并**首次对 KM3NeT 合作组报道的通量给出与光学 Cherenkov 探测器和粒子探测器互补的约束**。该上限还约束 UHECR 源模型，并在 90% 置信水平排除部分含跨 GZK 质子成分的模型。结果**证明将大型探测器阵列作为单一天文台运行并进行搜寻的可行性与灵敏度**，也凸显 Askaryan 探测器阵列对超高能中微子的高接收度和曝光。
summary: Ultrahigh energy neutrinos ($E_ν\gtrsim 100$ PeV) are detectable through Askaryan emission---the nanosecond-scale radio impulse emitted by relativistic particle cascades in a dielectric medium. The Askaryan Radio Array (ARA), an Askaryan detector array located at the South Pole, has been taking data for more than a decade. We present the first array-wide search for diffuse ultrahigh energy neutrinos with ARA. The search found no events on an expected background of $0.13\pm0.01\text{ (stat.)}^{+0.05}_{-0.06}\text{ (syst.)}$ events. The resulting upper limit is the most stringent from $50$ EeV to $1000$ EeV and provides the first constraints on the flux reported by the KM3NeT Collaboration that are complementary to optical Cherenkov and particle detectors. This limit also constrains UHECR source models, and excludes some models with trans-GZK proton populations at the $90\%$ confidence level. This represents the largest Askaryan detector dataset ever analyzed, demonstrating the feasibility and sensitivity of searches with large detector arrays acting as a single observatory. It also underscores the high acceptance and exposure of Askaryan detector arrays to ultrahigh energy neutrinos.

title: Tracing the Epoch of Reionization through extreme emission line galaxies around Cosmic Noon
background_knowledge:
宇宙再电离是宇宙演化中的关键相变：在复合之后，中性氢弥漫于星系际介质，而第一代星系和活动星系核的紫外辐射逐渐将其电离。当前主流图像认为，红移 $z > 6$ 的年轻、低质量、强恒星形成星系很可能是主要电离源；它们通过大量产生 Lyman 连续谱光子以及可能的逃逸通道，推动周围介质电离。然而，这些星系本身暗弱且尺寸小，即使使用 JWST 也难对单个系统做高信噪比、多波段和光谱研究，因此寻找低红移的物理类比体成为重要研究范式。
\n极端发射线星系（EELGs）是致密、低质量、具有极强星云发射线的恒星形成系统，常表现出很高的比恒星形成率（sSFR）和较强的 [OIII]、H$\beta$、H$\alpha$ 等发射线。它们与再电离时代的高红移星系在质量、尺寸、星暴强度和电离参数上可能有相似性，且位于较低红移、亮度更高，因而更便于开展大规模测光和光谱确认。围绕宇宙正午（$z \sim 1$–$3$）系统研究 EELGs，可以检验其作为高红移电离源低红移类比体的可靠性，并约束星系质量、金属丰度和恒星形成随宇宙时间的变化。
\n该方向通常结合多波段测光预选（如利用 J 波段颜色超出挑选强 H$\beta$ + [OIII] 或 H$\alpha$ 发射体）、光学/近红外光谱确认、SED 或贝叶斯拟合获得恒星质量与恒星形成率，并通过完备性模拟和 AGN 诊断评估样本纯度。关键问题包括：低红移 EELGs 是否真的与 $z > 5$ 的 JWST 极端发射体属于同一物理族群，以及样本的选择函数和污染水平如何影响统计结论。
contribution: 作者在 CANDELS/EGS 场中利用 J 波段颜色超出判据，同时挑选 H$\beta$ + [OIII] 与 H$\alpha$ 发射体，构建了宇宙正午附近统计显著的 EELG 样本，并用 MMT/MMIRS、Keck/MOSFIRE、HST/WFC3、JWST/NIRSpec 以及 GTC/OSIRIS+ 光谱进行验证。样本包含 **102 个 $z \sim 1.7$ 的 H$\beta$ + [OIII] 发射体和 127 个 $z \sim 1.0$ 的 H$\alpha$ 发射体**；它们致密（约 1.6 kpc）、低质量（$\log(M_\star/M_\odot) \sim 8$）且强烈恒星形成（sSFR $\sim 10^{-8}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$）。估计纯度分别为 **$84.3 \pm 1.5\%$** 和 **$76.8 \pm 2.0\%$**，与光谱确认率（$85\%$ 和 $63\%$）相符，且 **没有显著 AGN 污染证据**。通过截断似然函数进行完备性校正后的联合贝叶斯拟合给出 $\log(M_\star/M_\odot) = (6.71 \pm 0.16) + (3.31 \pm 0.46)\log(1+z)$，表明该样本的特征质量随宇宙时间演化。总体而言，作者**光谱确认了一个高纯度、无 AGN 的宇宙正午 EELG 样本**；尽管其质量尺度随红移演化，样本性质与 $z > 5$ 的 JWST 极端发射体一致，**支持这类星系作为再电离时代星系的中间红移类比体**。
summary: Star-forming galaxies at z>6 are thought to be the main drivers of cosmic reionization, but their faintness makes detailed study challenging even with JWST. Extreme Emission Line Galaxies (EELGs) are compact, low-mass systems with intense nebular emission and are potential lower-redshift analogues of this population. We aim to assemble and characterize a statistically significant sample of EELGs in the CANDELS/EGS field around cosmic noon, and to assess their validity as analogues of the galaxies that drove reionization. We select EELG candidates from CANDELS photometry with a J-band color-excess criterion that identifies both H$β$+[OIII] and H$α$ emitters. Physical properties are taken from CANDELS data products, and the selection is validated with MMT/MMIRS, Keck/MOSFIRE, HST/WFC3 and JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy, complemented by our own GTC/OSIRIS+ program. We identify 102 H$β$+[OIII] emitters at $z\sim1.7$ and 127 H$α$ emitters at $z\sim1.0$. They are compact ($\sim$1.6 kpc), low-mass ($\log(M_\star/M_\odot)\sim8$) and strongly star-forming (sSFR $\sim10^{-8}$ yr$^{-1}$). Estimated purities of $84.3\pm1.5$\% (H$β$+[OIII]) and $76.8\pm2.0$\% (H$α$) agree with spectroscopic confirmation rates (85\% and 63\%), with no evidence of significant AGN contamination. A joint Bayesian fit, corrected for completeness via a truncated likelihood, yields $\log(M_\star/M_\odot) = (6.71\pm0.16) + (3.31\pm0.46)\log(1+z)$, suggesting an evolution in the characteristic mass of the sample with cosmic time. We spectroscopically confirm a highly pure, AGN-free sample of cosmic-noon EELGs. While their mass scale evolves with redshift, their properties consistently match those of z>5 JWST extreme emitters, supporting them as intermediate-redshift analogues.
